name: F#
criteria: Functional-first .NET: discriminated unions with exhaustive match, pipelines over Seq/List/Map/Set, active patterns for parsing, tail recursion, plus mutable arrays and PriorityQueue when speed matters; good for parsing into ADTs, folds and expression trees.
build: mkdir -p .build && { [ -e .build/ok ] && [ -z "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.fs*' -newer .build/ok)" ] || { touch .build/new && dotnet build -c Release -o .build/out --nologo -v q -clp:NoSummary && mv .build/new .build/ok; }; }
